safe_state.switch: hold configured A2A sender and receiver settings unchanged
safe_state.description: Do not change peer URLs, authentication, ports, or gateway state automatically. A failed or missing runtime probe requires human review.

sampling.what: Daily result of the configured A2A runtime-state probe; report status only, never peer URLs or authentication values.
sampling.working_well: A configured A2A runtime is explicitly connected; missing configuration or runtime state is reported as unavailable, never green.

open_decisions: Confirm the actual gateway_state.json connected-state schema and whether connected establishes the configured sender-to-peer link. If it does not, approve a harmless bounded probe before using this check as link-health evidence.
